issues.issue: Judgment call. 'State ... Allocation' reads as pro-rate motor vehicle money (state aid), but it could be the county's distribution of motor vehicle tax, which would make it 'motor vehicle tax'. The same applies to detail[3] and detail[17] (detail_category 'motor vehicle pro-rate').

This is a bond administration fee paid from the Debt Service Fund. The rules put debt fees under 'debt service interest (including fees)'. detail[22] (Bond Maintenance, p5) also has category 'general government' with detail_category 'debt interest and fees', while detail[21] Bond Issue Costs uses 'debt service interest'. The categories are inconsistent.
